WESTHEAD GATES — the site as built
Direction: Forged (charcoal #0e1114 + brass #c8a24a)
Type: Sora (headings) / Instrument Sans (body)

These four pages are built, tested and pushed. Everything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a placeholder for real business detail.

The SEO plan is on the second page — use the pages menu in the toolbar.

GALLERY — the auto-loading bit
No hard-coded image list. A PHP script reads /images/ and builds this grid at page load.

Drop a JPEG in the folder → it appears. Sub-folders become the filter buttons. Filenames become captions — and, for SEO, alt text.

CONTACT
Form posts to a PHP handler on the same server and emails you — no third-party form service.

Honeypot, time-trap and per-IP rate limit built in. Works with JavaScript off.

HEAVILY SEO'd — what that actually means

You rank a page, not a site. Four pages can compete for about four phrases, so "heavy SEO" is mostly an ARCHITECTURE decision, not a markup one: roughly 28 pages instead of 4.

Read these three in order:
  1. Site architecture — the page tree and what each page targets
  2. Service page template — the anatomy that does the ranking
  3. Technical SEO spec — head tags, schema, images, build order

Two things I'd want you to read properly rather than skim: the doorway-page warning on board 1, and section 5 on board 3 — the part that isn't the website.

Nothing here is built yet. This is the plan to approve or cut down.

DECISIONS I NEED FROM YOU

• Which towns do you genuinely work in, in priority order?
• Which services earn the most, and which do you want more of? (Those get pages first.)
• Real price ranges — the single highest-value content on the site.
• Are you happy to commit to one guide a month? If not, we cut /guides/ from the plan rather than build a section that goes stale.
